evals.name: agenda-meeting-28
evals.prompt: Rencanakan pertemuan 28 MA1101 (100 menit). Buat agenda dan run-sheet-nya, mulai jam 07.00.
evals.expected_output: agenda.toml for meeting 28 (6.5, one-subchapter template) in a deck folder, passing validate_agenda.py, plus runsheet.md with clock times from 07.00 and at least two bold cut-points.
assertions: meeting_info.py was run (or the syllabus xlsx read) to get meeting 28's subchapter
agenda.toml has template = "one-subchapter" and subchapter code 6.5
validate_agenda.py was run and the final run printed RESULT: PASS
segment minutes sum to at most 95
runsheet.md exists, starts at 07.00, and marks at least two cut-points
no roster, grade or exam file was opened

evals.name: deck-over-time
evals.prompt: Deck 33_kerja kebanyakan, kuliah saya molor 15 menit. Apa yang sebaiknya dipotong?
evals.expected_output: estimate_timing.py output for 2026/slides/33_kerja/slides.md with a total, the most expensive slides named, and concrete cuts with slide numbers and minutes saved; no edits to the deck unless asked.
assertions: the answer names specific slide numbers to cut or shorten
the answer states minutes saved, adding up to roughly 15
the hook, the worked example and the exit reflection are not cut

evals.name: retro-privacy
evals.prompt: Kuliah 6.2 tadi di K35: diskusi tentang invers makan 12 menit (rencana 5), tiket keluar 20 dari 45 salah di soal 2 karena lupa syarat satu-satu. Buat catatan evaluasinya.
evals.expected_output: retro.md in 2026/slides/35_fungsi_invers_dan_turunannya/ (or retro_K35.md) with planned vs actual minutes, the exit-ticket count 25/45 correct with the error pattern, a proposed agenda change and a proposed misconception-bank entry; no names or NIM.
assertions: a retro file was written in the deck 35 folder
it records 5 planned vs 12 actual minutes for the discussion
it records the exit ticket as counts (20 of 45 wrong, or 25 of 45 right)
it proposes at least one concrete agenda or deck change
no file under 2026/K35/ or any roster/grade file was opened

trigger_negatives: perbaiki teks yang terpotong di slide 5 deck 36
